summary.cpu_seconds_scope: collector and waited-child rusage only; not exhaustive descendant CPU

process_tree_cpu.scope: Each cell creates fresh workers. Per-process self user+system maxima deduplicated by pid/birth, plus exact collector rusage. Excludes children_user/system fields and does not double count ancestry. Sampled maxima miss unobserved processes/final tails and incomplete reads. Known lower bound takes the maximum of overlapping observed counters, never their sum. This is a lower bound, not exact total CPU, phase attribution, or a wall-time correction. Native outcomes and primary whole-time rule are unchanged.
